title: JASON'S BACKSTORY — GTA VI
label: ROCKSTAR-CONFIRMED CHARACTER
script: Jason wants an easy life, but everything keeps getting harder. Rockstar says he grew up around grifters and crooks. After his troubled teens, he tried to change course in the Army. He ends up in the Keys, working for local drug runners. Rockstar says meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing for Jason.
